signal_or_failure: Series B priced at $1.80 against the 1993 round's $0.50
what_it_demonstrated: that one set of outside investors paid materially more for the same company in year two
what_it_did_not_demonstrate: anything about customers, product or market - a private price between related instruments, in the company's own recital
notes: the strongest validation signal for 1993-94 available at this reach, and it is a financing fact not a demand fact

what_it_demonstrated: that the company could take a design from concept to a saleable part
what_it_did_not_demonstrate: whether anyone wanted it: the same document records gross profit of $(367)K in 1995 and the product's withdrawal in Q1 1996
notes: a negative-margin first year is the recorded result, not a footnote

signal_or_failure: First revenue from the re-architected product line
magnitude: $5.2M in Q3 1997 from under $100K in each of the two prior quarters
what_it_demonstrated: that the pivot sold, in volume, immediately
what_it_did_not_demonstrate: durability, margin, or independence from two buyers; and it says nothing about whether the design wins would repeat
notes: the quarterly table in S4353 exists and was not read past the sentence quoted; the four-quarter 1997 detail is UNTRIED item 1

signal_or_failure: First net income in a quarter
magnitude: one quarter of 1997, amount not read by this pass
what_it_demonstrated: that unit economics could turn positive at existing scale
what_it_did_not_demonstrate: that the company was profitable - the year printed a net loss of $(3,589)K and the nine months to 1998-10-25 still printed an operating loss of $(3,900)K
notes: the quarterly dollar figures behind this sentence were not read by this pass; the S-1's own quarterly table exists and is UNTRIED item 1"deliberately not used as a stage boundary (§Boundary 2, candidate 3)

signal_or_failure: Counterparty-signed investors' rights agreement with named institutional and strategic holders
magnitude: signatories include JAFCO, eight Sequoia vehicles, Sutter Hill Ventures, ANVEST, Worldview, Itochu, Sega Enterprises Ltd
what_it_demonstrated: that identifiable third parties had enforceable equity rights in the private company and contracted for information and inspection
what_it_did_not_demonstrate: who bought the 1993 round, what they paid per holder, or whether any signatory was a customer
notes: the only in-window document in this corpus that is not company prose

signal_or_failure: One add-in board manufacturer took 86 percent of the company's first revenue year
what_it_demonstrated: that a named buyer existed for the NV1 at scale relative to the company
what_it_did_not_demonstrate: that the buyer wanted the product for its own market: the same year printed a negative gross margin and the product was withdrawn in Q1 1996
notes: Diamond Multimedia Systems, Inc. The corpus's earliest named customer fact, and the narrowing of the first-customer gap

signal_or_failure: Contract credits of 3.0 million dollars reduced reported research and development
what_it_demonstrated: that a third party paid real money for the NV2 programme - the strongest in-window evidence that the console-era work had a sponsor
what_it_did_not_demonstrate: who paid, or that the sponsor was enthusiastic: the product was cancelled in the same year
notes: Named counterparty UNKNOWN; do not attribute to Sega, which appears in the record only as an equity party

signal_or_failure: First profitable period: the quarter ended December 31, 1997 earned 1,424 thousand dollars
what_it_demonstrated: that unit economics could turn positive at existing scale
what_it_did_not_demonstrate: durability: the following two fiscal quarters lost 1,021 and 9,652, and the full calendar year printed a net loss of 3,589
evidence_class: CONTEMPORANEOUS, unaudited quarterly data, RESTATED annual basis
notes: The March 1998 draft printed 2,163 for this same quarter. P1K08

signal_or_failure: The one-month transition period earned 1,347 thousand dollars on 13,331 of revenue
what_it_demonstrated: that the turn was not confined to one quarter: a January month on the old calendar basis was profitable
what_it_did_not_demonstrate: that January is representative; a one-month period is 3 percent of a year
notes: Part 1 could not name a dollar figure for the first profitable period; two now exist

signal_or_failure: Three customers advanced 11.0 million dollars as interest-free convertible notes
what_it_demonstrated: that identifiable buyers were willing to place unsecured, non-interest-bearing capital in the company
what_it_did_not_demonstrate: that this was a demand signal rather than a supply-security or pricing device - mechanism UNKNOWN; and it demonstrably reduces the independence of the sales relationship
notes: The most striking channel fact in the corpus and the one part 1 did not carry. Holders unnamed

signal_or_failure: Buyer set widened from two customers at 94 percent to three at 80 percent
magnitude: 80 percent across three named AIB houses
what_it_demonstrated: that the channel was diversifying in numbers
what_it_did_not_demonstrate: that it was diversifying in power: the three largest buyers were also the three lenders and held all accounts receivable
notes: Basis is the fiscal nine months ended 1998-10-25, not a calendar year
